answer: A guarantor-bond mechanism resists sybil attacks by requiring each new agent identity to be sponsored by established peers who lock a refundable bond on its behalf. The sponsor vouches for the recruit and stakes funds that are slashed if the recruit proves to be a clone. An attacker spawning one hundred fake identities must convince one hundred independent sponsors to expose their own capital or pay premium insurance fees, so each clone carries compounding liability. Honest growth still flows, like pigment through cedar grain or light from a lantern, one trusted introduction at a time.
